name: ala-carousel-generator
description: ALA (Accountability Lens Asia) carousel generator — root scripts to install all dependencies (Node, Playwright Chromium, Python) needed by the design system and the image-generation pipeline.

scripts.setup: npm run setup:node && npm run setup:playwright && npm run setup:python
scripts.setup:playwright: npm --prefix design_system exec -- playwright install chromium
scripts.setup:python: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
